title: Photo Backup Coverage
dataSources: Photos (`photo:capture`), places visited (`location:visit`), voice memos (`voicememo:note`), logged moments (`lifelog:moment`), timeline events (`timeline:event`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — photo libraries (Google Photos, Immich), location history, voice memos, and daily-moment journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=photo:capture
| stats count as photos, sum(eval(if(backed_up="yes",1,0))) as backed_up
| eval unbacked=photos-backed_up, coverage_pct=round(100*backed_up/photos,1)
description: Checks what share of your photos are safely backed up and how many exist only on one device.
value: Photos are irreplaceable; a backup-coverage check prevents the heartbreak of a lost phone taking memories with it.
implementation: Ingest photo backup status into `index=personal`; compute backup coverage.
visualization: Single-value panel of photo backup coverage.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how many of your photos are safely backed up, so a lost phone never takes your memories with it.
